# eSIM.dog

> Prepaid travel eSIMs and related products.

## Product and price catalogue

- [Complete product and price catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasssileek/llms-reading-test-20261110/50bd54aba31b38ff4156dab20a1dd5954c6c4c80/local-v58-20261116/llms-full.txt): Prices in USD, data allowances, durations, speeds, coverage, product information and purchase links.

## Regional fixed eSIMs by destination

Regional category names are shop labels. Each listed category has at least one fixed eSIM that covers the destination. Coverage, data sizes, durations and prices vary by offer.
